findings.message: PromptTemplateRegistryPort properly defines the outbound port interface with resolve_template(use_case, locale, role, age_band, version), list_versions(use_case), and get_regression_fixtures(use_case) methods.

InRepoPromptTemplateRegistry adapter loads templates and fixtures from JSON files. Resolution logic scores candidates by locale/role/age-band compatibility, chooses newest semantic version among best-compatible templates, enforces Polish locale for kid/child age-band requests, and supports explicit version pinning.

Versioned prompt templates in data/ai/prompt_templates.json include use-case templates for creation help, creation explain, gameplay hints, and parent script prompts, with locale variants (pl-PL, en-US) and versioned entries including 1.1.0 kid creation template.
Regression fixtures tracked in data/ai/prompt_regression_fixtures.json for use by quality-gate suites, enabling consistent validation of prompt template behavior.

RequestAICreationHelpService now optionally consumes registry templates for ai_creation_help and ai_creation_explain. RequestGameplayHintService consumes templates for gameplay_hint. ParentScriptEditorService consumes templates for parent_script_explain and parent_script_refactor.
Existing behavior preserved via fallback: when registry is not injected, services continue to use their existing fallback prompts, ensuring backward compatibility.

Contract test coverage added for port and adapter behavior. Integration contract verifies kid path remains Polish by default, parent language override path uses non-Polish templates when policy allows, and prompt content reflects resolved templates.
Focused TASK-044 test runner created and passes with Tests: 3  Checks: 27  Failed tests: 0. Regression validation via run_task_032_tests.gd also passes with Tests: 4  Checks: 51.
